name: The Silencer
source:
The Silencer is a visual novel horror game about a girl who gets kidnapped by a serial killer called "The Silencer". 

He keeps her in a cage.

Will she escape?

[from [url=https://licehound.itch.io/the-silencer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The Silencer》是一款视觉小说恐怖游戏，讲述了一个女孩被名为“The Silencer”的连环杀手绑架的故事。

他把她关在笼子里。

她会逃跑吗？

[来自[url=https://licehound.itch.io/the-silencer]itch.io[/url]]
